recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No further core source work is needed for FHIR-25283 unless CQI later changes the MeasureReport.evaluatedResource report-scope model.
issue_request: FHIR-25283 was a Published/Persuasive CQI change request for R5 asking the MeasureReport.evaluatedResource definition to stop saying it was a reference to a Bundle containing Resources and instead reflect the repeating references to Resources used in measure calculation.
initial_application: The issue was explicitly applied in d14f95267ae327335084154ede0ae1374aab146d, included in PR #2301 merged as fb1432b6921ab1318d4cfb5fc91e93ab0d5ddbff, which changed the active MeasureReport StructureDefinition definition from a Bundle reference to a Resource reference.
additional_context: MeasureReport is active in source/fhir.ini. A related earlier FHIR-27026 commit touched the same phrase, and later Published issue FHIR-34033 refined evaluatedResource's bounded report-scope wording. The current combined branch keeps evaluatedResource as 0..* Reference(Resource) and describes references to subject-specific resources for individual reports and data-of-interest for data-exchange reports, with no restored Bundle-only wording.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current in-build StructureDefinition already satisfies the seed's semantic request through the 0..* Reference(Resource) type and current non-Bundle definition text.
